title: MSFS 2020 Marketplace Update (April 4th 2026) – NEW Real-World Airport & Airline Schedules!
description:
Explore the latest MSFS 2020 Marketplace Update for PC! This week, VA SYSTEMS has released a massive wave of real-world airline and airport schedule activities based on the Winter 2025 operations. Whether you are flying long-haul into Tokyo Haneda (RJTT) or managing a busy US hub like George Bush Intercontinental (KIAH), these MSFS activities are essential for pilots seeking maximum realism in Microsoft Flight Simulator.

In this video, we break down all the new MSFS traffic schedules and mission packs added to the MSFS PC Marketplace this April.

🗺️ New activities added this week (PC)
The following activity (missions & miscellaneous) was newly released in the marketplace this week:

🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: DNMM – Murtala Muhammed International Airport (Realistic Winter 2025 airport traffic schedules)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: EBBR – Brussels Airport (Updated airline movements based on Winter 2025 ops)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: KIAH – George Bush Intercontinental Airport (Busy US hub real‑world schedule activity)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: RJTT – Tokyo Haneda Airport (High‑density Asian traffic operations)
🗺️ VA SYSTEMS: SBRR – Boa Vista International Airport (Regional Winter 2025 scheduling)

If you enjoyed this weekly MSFS Marketplace update, don’t forget to like the video, subscribe for more Microsoft Flight Simulator news, and let me know in the comments which schedule pack you’ll be flying first!
✈️ See you in the skies!
